IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long,
straight black hair and wispy bangs
smiles brightly with her head tilted. She
wears a white and mint ruffled costume
with ribbon ties at the shoulders and
waist, a mint cap with white cross details
and lace trim, and a mint choker. Her
hands are clasped near her chest. A
pale wood-panel backdrop with soft,
even light. Palette of mint, white, and
soft pink skin. Sweet and playful, in the
style of a cheerful costume-cosplay
photo.
